items.title: Pricing & Project Lead
items.content_html:
We're Tibber - the energy company that wants you to use less energy.

When you join Tibber, you'll help shape how an entire industry gets reimagined – from how we reach new customers, to how we build a brand that hundreds of thousands of people trust with something as fundamental as their energy. You'll be part of a real shift in how people consume electricity – good for our users, their wallets and the planet.

We’re looking for a Pricing & Project Lead to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?

Job Mission 🚀

As our Pricing & Project Lead, you'll shape how Tibber grows most efficiently across markets and channels. You'll set the pricing guardrails every channel works within, recommend where we invest, and dig deep to find new ways to grow - with CAC, payback and LTV in mind.

What you'll do ✅

  • Build and own the marketing budget model - an algorithmic model with adjustable variables that recommends how we split spend across our different plans, markets and channels, based on discounts, CAC, markup, payback and LTV.

  • Own discount pricing mechanics - which discount levels we apply in which channels, and why.

  • Recommend growth initiatives where you see potential for efficient growth.

  • Build the tracking and reporting structure: LTV and CAC by customer profile, so AI agents get the input they need, and report on actuals and growth.

  • Lead deep dives and special projects - from growth hacking with new deal types to offers that bring several Tibber products into one package.

What we're looking for⚡

You are driven by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:

  • You have a top-tier management consultancy background and have worked in an operating company, ideally in energy or another growth startup.

  • You have worked hands-on with pricing, and built the frameworks, reporting and tracking around it.

  • You understand a P&L and how pricing and growth decisions flow through it.

  • You have strong quantitative skills, model CAC, payback, LTV and discounting yourself, and love a deep dive.

  • Hands-on experience with AI in analysis and modelling is a plus. Tibber is becoming more AI-enabled, and we embrace new tools and ways of working.

The Tibber Mindset 💆🏻‍♀️💆🏽‍♂️

Tibber exists to drive energy independence – away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours, strengthening the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.

Being on a mission to change an industry means being prepared for the unexpected. We do what others say can't be done – and we do it together. We win, fail and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better - every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we believe it's how we accelerate the energy transition. The more it becomes part of how we operate, the more our Tibberinos matter.

Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Berlin, Amsterdam, Oslo and Førde. Backed by Balderton Capital, Eight Roads Ventures, Founders Fund, Summa and Schibsted. Still just getting started.

Diversity of thought fuels better products, so we welcome applicants of every background, identity and lived experience. Ready to be part of powering the energy transition? Apply below!

items.title: AI Commercial Lead - Price Portals
items.content_html:
We're Tibber - the energy company that wants you to use less energy.

When you join Tibber, you'll help shape how an entire industry gets reimagined – from how we reach new customers, to how we build a brand that hundreds of thousands of people trust with something as fundamental as their energy. You'll be part of a real shift in how people consume electricity – good for our users, their wallets and the planet.

We’re looking for a AI Commercial Lead to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?

Job Mission 🚀

As our AI Commercial Lead for the price portals, you'll own our growth targets from one of our biggest channels across our four markets. You'll own the partner deals and the pricing that drive them, and build hands-on AI to help customers find Tibber and save on energy.

What you'll do ✅

  • Own the results of the price portal channel across our four markets. Build hands-on with AI to keep developing our agentic go-to-market towards the portals. You will have a partner in the technology department.

  • Own the agents you build end to end – keep them running, track how they perform and update them as the portals, prices and markets change.

  • Own partner deals with the portals – commissions, placement and terms – in each of our markets.

  • Own pricing in the portals – mainly discounting – setting your own limits within our group pricing guardrails, so growth stays profitable.

  • Build the frameworks for the channel, including structure, reporting and tracking, plugging into our central reporting, and own them over time.

  • When an agent scales and gets complex, bring in Product & Engineering to take it into production.

What we're looking for⚡

You are driven by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:

  • You have worked in an operating company, ideally in energy or another growth startup. A top-tier management consultancy background is a big plus.

  • You have worked hands-on with AI, built and delivered agents, and you think hard about how to get AI incorporated into the way a business runs.

  • You understand a P&L, or have owned growth targets before. You have hands-on experience with pricing and discounting within guardrails, and have negotiated commercial partner deals yourself.

  • You have built and owned frameworks, setting up the structure, reporting and tracking for your area.

  • You're comfortable working with full autonomy in a space where no playbook exists yet.

The more it becomes part of how we operate, the more our Tibberinos matter.

items.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
items.content_html:
We’re Tibber - the energy company that wants you to use less energy. When you join us, you’ll help shape how an entire industry gets reimagined – from how we reach new customers, to how we build a brand that hundreds of thousands of people trust with something as fundamental as their energy. You’ll be part of a real shift in how people consume electricity – good for our users, their wallets and the planet.

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to join us – maybe that’s you?

Job Mission 🚀

As a Talent Acquisition Partner at Tibber, you’ll be the growth engine of building and scaling our organisation, and every hire you make helps power the future of energy. You’ll join a team with a seat at the table, part of our People function and reporting directly to our CPO. We’re already rethinking how hiring works in an AI-native world, and we want you along for the ride.

What you'll do ✅

  • Own the entire hiring flow, from mapping the market and crafting the story to signing the offer.

  • Hire across Commercial, Corporate functions and Tech & Product, in all four of our markets.

  • Partner with your hiring managers and share the secrets of our craft, so great hiring stays a team effort.

  • Meet talent where they are, and keep our pipelines warm even when we’re not actively hiring.

  • Use data and AI to keep our processes silky-smooth.

  • Drive Employer Branding with Marketing and help shape the strategy, so talent across Europe knows our name before we reach out.

What we're looking for⚡

We believe you are a versatile Talent Acquisition Partner with 4+ years of experience owning full-cycle recruitment in a high-pace, product-obsessed environment, in-house or as an embedded consultant. You’ll thrive at Tibber if you:

  • Love the craft. You’ve owned hiring across many kinds of roles, and every process gets the same care. You see diversity as a strategy - your search strings are wide and your interviews structured.

  • Get the business. You understand what drives Tibber and how each hire moves the needle.

  • Coach, not coerce. Hiring managers leave your 1:1s clearer, faster and more inclusive. You push back when needed and still keep everyone smiling.

  • Know what matters most. Many open roles and shifting priorities keep you sharp, Time-to-hire, quality-of-hire and pipeline diversity aren’t vanity metrics, they’re how you make the call.

  • Speak LLM fluently, and know when not to. Tibber becomes more AI-enabled every day, and you’re excited to grow with it. AI is your sidekick, but human judgment stays in the driver’s seat.

  • Are a people person with stakeholder superpowers. You earn trust fast, with candidates, hiring managers and colleagues alike.

  • Get excited by Employer Branding. You’ve done hands-on EB work and want to grow into shaping the strategy.

  • Communicate sharply in English. It’s our company language, and Swedish, German or Dutch is a plus since you’ll hire across all our markets.

The Tibber Mindset 💆🏻‍♀️💆🏽‍♂️

Being on a mission to change an industry means being prepared for the unexpected. We do what others say can’t be done and we do it together. We win, fail and grow while staying curious and pushing for the better. AI is shaping how we work - and we believe it’s how we accelerate the energy transition. The more it becomes part of how we operate, the more our Tibberinos matter.

Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Berlin, Amsterdam, Oslo and Førde. Backed by Balderton Capital, Eight Roads Ventures, Founders Fund, Summa and Schibsted. Still just getting started.

items.title: Customer Support Specialist (m/f/d)
items.content_html:
We're Tibber - the energy company that wants you to use less energy.

When you join Tibber, you'll work directly with the people we exist for, our customers. Helping them understand, control and benefit from their energy use, every day. You'll be part of a real shift in how people consume electricity – good for our customers, their wallets and the planet.

We're looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join us – maybe that's you?

Job Mission 🚀

Do you get energy from delivering high-quality support, building trust, and bringing structure to complex operations? If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy balancing customer needs with operational excellence, you’ll fit right in.

As a Customer Support Specialist you’ll focus on delivering world-class support to our customers. You’ll play a central role in providing exceptional service and support to our customers while contributing to our mission to revolutionise the energy industry.

What you'll do ✅

  • Customer support across channels: Build strong, lasting relationships with Tibber customers through phone, chat and email.

  • Problem solving and technical support: Research and resolve questions quickly, from app issues and charger integrations to billing, contracts and account updates. Keep accurate records in our CRM.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work with Support, Sales, Technical Support and Back Office to keep the customer journey smooth.

  • Product and energy expertise: Build deep knowledge of Tibber’s products, services and technology. Help customers find ways to save energy and see how Tibber contributes to sustainability.

  • Quality and improvement: Contribute to team KPIs and help improve workflows. Be the voice of the customer by turning what you hear into feedback that improves our products and services.

What we're looking for⚡

We don’t expect the perfect profile, but it would look something like this:

  • Experience in customer service/support/operations with strong problem-solving skills, from technical troubleshooting to in-depth billing support.

  • A customer-oriented mentality and an empathetic attitude. You enjoy helping!

  • Clear, professional and empathetic communication, written and verbal. Due to the specialization on the German market, tickets (or messages) and general customer communication is mostly in German and our business language is English, fluency in both languages is a requirement.

  • Technical literacy. You’re comfortable in a technology-driven environment, learn new tools quickly and easily adapt to new ways of working.

  • An interest in smart energy products, a belief that sustainability matters in business, and a drive to improve how we work.

We understand that no one ticks every box, but if you recognize yourself in some parts of this, you are more than welcome to apply!

items.title: Hardware Product Manager
items.content_html:
We're Tibber - the energy company that wants you to use less energy.

When you join Tibber, you'll be part of building the tech that creates a real shift in how people consume electricity - good for our users, their wallets and the planet. We believe AI is how we accelerate that shift, and it's our people who lead it. The more we lean into AI, the more human judgment, curiosity and creativity matter.

We're looking for a Hardware Product Manager to join us – maybe that's you?

Job Mission 🚀

As a Hardware Product Manager, you'll play a key role in bringing Tibber's smart energy hardware, from the Pulse family to our next generation, into customers' homes. You'll build the specs, change control and certification that let our hardware scale across markets.

What you'll do ✅

  • Own the hardware and firmware roadmap for the Pulse family and next-generation devices, including OTA rollout gates

  • Turn ideas into clear PRDs and specs, covering industrial design, on-device behaviour, packaging and the unboxing experience

  • Run NPI end to end with our manufacturing partners, making sure we manufacture our product with high standards, following specification and in full coordination with Supply Chain.

  • Keep production under control: the right spec and revision, with every engineering change recorded before it reaches the line

  • Secure CE and other certifications in every market, including cybersecurity and energy regulation, so we stay compliant and secure.

  • Close the loop with Support: track field failures and returns, fix what you can in the field, and improve the next revision

  • Give the hardware and firmware team its focus, and work closely with an Experience PM and our external design, manufacturing and test partners.

What we're looking for⚡

You are driven by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:

  • Have 5+ years in connected hardware product development, owning a roadmap and specs

  • Have successfully taken one or several hardware products through the full development process, and then run the NPI to volume production with a contract manufacturer

  • Have led CE certification (LVD, EMC, RED) with test labs

  • Have owned the roadmap and specs for a product where hardware, firmware and cloud meet, including OTA updates in the field

  • Have the technical depth to challenge engineering and supplier decisions, from an EE/ME degree or equivalent hands-on experience

  • Create structure where there is none, and hold partners to spec, cost and timeline

  • Are excited that Tibber is becoming more AI-enabled. You don't need to be an expert, but we believe you're motivated to use new tools and grow with them

Bonus: energy hardware (smart meters, EV chargers, batteries), RMA and failure analysis, packaging regulation (PPWR) or B2B2C channels. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.

_jobposting.title: Hardware Product Manager
_jobposting.description:
We're Tibber - the energy company that wants you to use less energy.

When you join Tibber, you'll be part of building the tech that creates a real shift in how people consume electricity - good for our users, their wallets and the planet. We believe AI is how we accelerate that shift, and it's our people who lead it. The more we lean into AI, the more human judgment, curiosity and creativity matter.

We're looking for a Hardware Product Manager to join us – maybe that's you?

Job Mission 🚀

As a Hardware Product Manager, you'll play a key role in bringing Tibber's smart energy hardware, from the Pulse family to our next generation, into customers' homes. You'll build the specs, change control and certification that let our hardware scale across markets.

What you'll do ✅

  • Own the hardware and firmware roadmap for the Pulse family and next-generation devices, including OTA rollout gates

  • Turn ideas into clear PRDs and specs, covering industrial design, on-device behaviour, packaging and the unboxing experience

  • Run NPI end to end with our manufacturing partners, making sure we manufacture our product with high standards, following specification and in full coordination with Supply Chain.

  • Keep production under control: the right spec and revision, with every engineering change recorded before it reaches the line

  • Secure CE and other certifications in every market, including cybersecurity and energy regulation, so we stay compliant and secure.

  • Close the loop with Support: track field failures and returns, fix what you can in the field, and improve the next revision

  • Give the hardware and firmware team its focus, and work closely with an Experience PM and our external design, manufacturing and test partners.

What we're looking for⚡

You are driven by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:

  • Have 5+ years in connected hardware product development, owning a roadmap and specs

  • Have successfully taken one or several hardware products through the full development process, and then run the NPI to volume production with a contract manufacturer

  • Have led CE certification (LVD, EMC, RED) with test labs

  • Have owned the roadmap and specs for a product where hardware, firmware and cloud meet, including OTA updates in the field

  • Have the technical depth to challenge engineering and supplier decisions, from an EE/ME degree or equivalent hands-on experience

  • Create structure where there is none, and hold partners to spec, cost and timeline

  • Are excited that Tibber is becoming more AI-enabled. You don't need to be an expert, but we believe you're motivated to use new tools and grow with them

Bonus: energy hardware (smart meters, EV chargers, batteries), RMA and failure analysis, packaging regulation (PPWR) or B2B2C channels. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.

The Tibber Mindset 💆🏻‍♀️💆🏽‍♂️

Tibber exists to drive energy independence – away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours, strengthening the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.

Being on a mission to change an industry means being prepared for the unexpected. We do what others say can't be done – and we do it together. We win, fail and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better - every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we believe it's how we accelerate the energy transition. The more it becomes part of how we operate, the more our Tibberinos matter.
